question: How does the eval regression gate decide whether a metric got worse than the baseline?
referenceAnswer: RegressionGate.Compare in src/Maf.Lab.Evaluation/RegressionGate.cs subtracts each metric's baseline value from the run's value and resolves a tolerance per metric name: a delta of zero or more is an Improvement, a drop within the tolerance (plus 1e-9 of slack) is Noise, and a larger drop is a Regression. A metric absent from the baseline is reported as New and a baseline metric the run did not produce as Missing; HasRegression is true when any comparison is a Regression.

question: In the code, what happens to a turn when one domain's MCP server fails, and when does the whole turn fail?
referenceAnswer: McpToolSource.GetToolsAsync in src/Maf.Lab.Api/Agent/ToolSource.cs connects to the MCP servers of the domains the turn needs at the same time. A server that fails leaves its domain's tools out of the turn: it logs a warning with only the domain and the kind of failure, never an address, adds the domain to the tool set's Unavailable list, and the turn runs with the tools it has. Only when every server the turn needs fails does it rethrow, and the turn fails as a whole. A cancellation is not caught as a server failure.
referencePoints: It is handled in McpToolSource.GetToolsAsync in src/Maf.Lab.Api/Agent/ToolSource.cs.
The servers of the domains the turn needs are contacted at the same time.

question: How does the BM25 tokenizer handle identifiers in source code?
referenceAnswer: Bm25Tokenizer.TokenizeCode in src/Maf.Lab.Retrieval/Sparse/Bm25Tokenizer.cs keeps every lowercased word the plain tokenizer keeps and then adds the parts of a camel- or Pascal-case identifier, splitting at lower-to-upper, at the last capital of an acronym, and between letters and digits, so "TenantScopedSearch" also yields "tenant", "scoped" and "search". Both tokenizers split on anything that is not a letter or digit and drop English stopwords.

question: What happens to a search excerpt that the content guard withholds?
referenceAnswer: Guardrail.ScreenToolResultAsync in src/Maf.Lab.Api/Agent/Guardrail.cs screens each excerpt of a search result on its own and withholds one when a question that may withhold scores at or above ContentWithholdAt (0.85 by default). The withheld excerpt is replaced in place by a stub that keeps only its path and line range or its docId plus withheld: true, and the result gets a withheld count and a notice telling the model to answer from the remaining data only.

question: How are procedure documents split into chunks for indexing?
referenceAnswer: ProcedureChunker in src/Maf.Lab.Indexing/Chunking/ProcedureChunker.cs takes the first non-empty line as the title and starts a new chunk at every section header ("Section 2: ...", "## ..." or an upper-case line) and at every numbered step ("1.", "1)" or "Step 1:"). Each chunk's path joins the title, section and step with " > ", and text that is too long is split to fit the chunk budget.

question: How does the LLM reranker reorder search candidates, and what happens if it fails?
referenceAnswer: LlmReranker in src/Maf.Lab.Retrieval/Rerank/Rerankers.cs asks the configured rerank model for a JSON order of passage indices, then scores the candidates 1/(rank+1) with any index missing from the order appended after. Fewer than two candidates are returned unchanged, and any failure other than cancellation is logged without content and returns the fused order.

question: В кода какво става с един ход, когато MCP сървърът на един домейн отпадне, и кога целият ход се проваля?
referenceAnswer: McpToolSource.GetToolsAsync в src/Maf.Lab.Api/Agent/ToolSource.cs се свързва едновременно с MCP сървърите на домейните, които ходът използва. Сървър, който отпадне, оставя инструментите на своя домейн извън хода: записва предупреждение само с домейна и вида на грешката, никога с адрес, добавя домейна в списъка Unavailable на набора от инструменти и ходът продължава с наличните инструменти. Само когато отпаднат всички сървъри, нужни на хода, грешката се хвърля отново и целият ход се проваля. Отказът (cancellation) не се третира като отпадане на сървър.
